propositions: The deprecated env var REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from all resolvers and prose documentation; the config key [tool.rebar.llm].model, CLI override -c llm.model, and per-step model: workflow override remain active.

A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL env var must fail loudly with RemovedInputError via a tombstone entry in the deprecation registry, matching the REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS precedent and preventing silent model changes that affect cost and quality.

All 15 test files that set REBAR_LLM_MODEL and build an LLMConfig must be retargeted to alternate channels ([tool.rebar.llm].model, per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL, or -c llm.model) to avoid raising RemovedInputError.

The deprecated bare-model fallback logic (_deprecated_bare_model function and fallback_default rung in model-class resolution) must be deleted, narrowing class precedence to CLI > per-class env > config table > built-in default.

Model resolution must be refactored to omit the env channel: _llm_str gains env_name parameter, docs/env-vars.md is regenerated, and all operator-facing prose in docs/ and infra/ shifts from 'deprecated' to 'removed' terminology.
